description_en: Disables or enables an interactive messaging application
name: ModifyLiveMessageAppDisable

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable the interactive messaging application
parameters.help_zh: 是否禁用互动消息应用
parameters.name: disable

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AppId.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application
AppId.description_zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID

AppSign.description_en: The signature of the interactive messaging application. It is required by the interactive messaging SDK
AppSign.description_zh: 互动消息应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息

Disable.description_en: Indicates whether the interactive messaging application is disabled
Disable.description_zh: 该互动消息应用是否禁用
